questions.stem: Is this typeface choice acceptable?

options.text: No, serious content needs a sober readable face

questions.explanation: Serious risk content needs a sober readable face; a comic face clashes with the register, though handwritten is not required.

questions.learningObjective: Finalise reserved colour use in a plan

stimulus.body: A plan must finalise a reserved colour scheme for warnings, links, and success.

questions.stem: Which colour scheme best preserves reserved meanings?

options.text: Blue for all three for consistency
Red for all three to keep it simple
Red for warnings, blue for links, green for success
Green for warnings, red for success

questions.explanation: Distinct colours for warnings, links, and success preserve each meaning, unlike collapsed or inverted schemes.
